title: ध्यान पर कौन-सा प्रमाण सबसे मजबूत है?
claimBoundary: This reel compares the scope of controlled experimental findings and systematic methodological synthesis in inattentional-blindness research. It does not use a clinical evidence hierarchy, give medical or safety advice, or infer traits from an individual missed detail.

claims.statementHi: एक controlled experiment अपने exact tested task और conditions के बारे में सबसे सीधा उत्तर देता है।
claims.limit: Do not represent this as a universal rule for every situation.

claims.statementHi: एक dynamic divided-attention experiment में noticing unexpected object की similarity और primary monitoring task की difficulty के साथ बदल सकती थी।
claims.limit: This finding is scoped to the study's dynamic display and task.

claims.statementHi: Tracking experiments ने attention set के category- और feature-based accounts को test किया; Wood और Simons के tested displays में filtering category-based थी।
claims.limit: Do not call this a final mechanism for all inattentional blindness.

claims.statementHi: A methodological review of 129 articles and 219 experiments found varied paradigms and argued that inattentional blindness may include subtypes with different mechanisms.
claims.limit: It is not a pooled causal effect estimate or a guarantee of real-world transfer.

claims.statementHi: एक missed detail intelligence, personality या diagnosis का proof नहीं है।
